(2) Frontend delete flow on Rate Wall — admin login → trash icon appears on tip cards → click → confirm dialog → card removed from wall without hard refresh → 'Tip deleted' toast fires. ui_bugs.issue: bell-settings-panel is NOT horizontally centered on mobile — it overflows off the right edge. Measured bounding box: x=195, width=320, right-edge=515 in a 390px viewport (125px cut off). Expected: left>=0 AND right<=390 AND horizontally centered.

action_items: Fix mobile centering in /app/frontend/src/components/NotificationBell.jsx line 162. The Tailwind class `-translate-x-1/2` is being nullified because Framer-motion sets inline `transform: none` (its animate={y:0, scale:1} collapses to identity transform, overriding Tailwind's transform utility). Result on mobile: computed style shows `left:195px; transform:none;` → panel starts at 50% viewport instead of centered around 50%.

Recommended fix (choose one): (a) Replace `left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] max-w-xs` with `left-4 right-4 w-auto max-w-xs mx-auto` so positioning doesn't rely on CSS transform. (b) Or add `x: '-50%'` to Framer motion's initial+animate+exit props so framer keeps the -50% X offset (e.g. initial={{opacity:0, y:-8, scale:0.96, x:'-50%'}}, animate={{opacity:1, y:0, scale:1, x:'-50%'}} — but this must be scoped to mobile only; simpler to drop transform-based centering).
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.jsx line 162: Mixing Tailwind transform utilities (`-translate-x-1/2`) with Framer-motion animated transforms is a known anti-pattern — framer's inline transform always wins. Refactor to positional (left/right offsets) or bake all transforms into motion props.

RateWall.jsx line 74: `window.confirm(...)` is used for delete confirmation — works functionally but breaks the design system (native browser dialog vs. shadcn AlertDialog). Consider using a controlled confirm modal for brand consistency.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: In /app/frontend/src/components/NotificationBell.jsx line 157-163, the settings panel uses a `motion.div` with `animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}`. When y=0 and scale=1 (identity transform), Framer-motion sets the element's inline `style.transform` (which resolves to 'none' or an identity matrix) — this overrides the Tailwind `-translate-x-1/2` utility class. Verified via computed style: `transform: 'none'` and `left: '195px'` (=50% of 390px viewport) with no -50% offset applied. Reproduction: viewport 390x844 → click [data-testid=notification-bell] → measure panel getBoundingClientRect() → x=195, width=320, right=515 (overflows by 125px). Fix: stop relying on CSS transform for horizontal centering; use left/right positional utilities (e.g., `left-4 right-4 mx-auto max-w-xs`) — or set `x: '-50%'` inside Framer's animate/initial/exit props so it isn't clobbered.
